invariants.rationale: The method is expected to return a non-null List of WriteStatus.
records is passed as a parameter and should not be null during insert operations.
instantTime is used to specify the commit time and should not be null.
The method returns a List<WriteStatus>, so result should always be a List at exit.
If records are provided (non-empty), result should also be non-empty; if records is empty, result should also be empty.
